description: A controller class for handling user-related HTTP requests in an ASP.NET Core application, including user creation and login endpoints.

classes.name: UsersController
classes.description: Controller for user operations, handling creation and login via HTTP POST endpoints using MediatR for request dispatching.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Handles user creation requests; forwards Create.Command via MediatR.

methods.name: Login
methods.description: Handles user login requests; forwards Login.Command via MediatR.
